transcript_id.description: Echo exactly the id given in the prompt: leader_slug/source_id.

attribution_notes.description: One or two sentences on how you told the subject's turns from the interviewer's.

statement_date_doubt.description: One answer for the whole transcript. See EXTRACTION.md section 1a and ELIGIBILITY.md: recording_older_than_stated holds every record of the transcript until the recording is dated. A doubt written only in notes is read by nothing.

evidence.description: The words from the title, description or transcript that show the recording is older, copied. Null when doubt is none.

evidence_year.description: The year the evidence names, or null.

quote.description: One contiguous verbatim span, 8 to 60 words, copied character for character.

timestamp_hint.description: The nearest [hh:mm:ss] mark at or before the quote, or 'unmarked'.

gate_notes.description: Why each gate passes, briefly. A human auditor reads this.

resolution_criteria.description: By <date or dated event>, <observable> <outcome>; for a figure for a period, For <period> (ending <date>), <figure> will be <outcome>, as reported at any time, never 'By <period end>, X will report'. State ONE direction, never the form 'will / will not'. Write it so that TRUE means the speaker was RIGHT: keep the speaker's own negation rather than flipping it. See ELIGIBILITY.md G2.

claim_form.description: From the words: conditional needs a stated precondition, ordering one thing before another, recurring a repeated event. See EXTRACTION.md section 8.

target_date.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; the latest date the speaker's words allow. Null when EXTRACTION.md section 1a forbids resolving the words against the statement date.

target_date_text.description: The speaker's exact words that fix the date, including vague ones such as 'soon' or 'in the coming months'.

probability.description: Only a number the speaker stated. Never a translation of words.

verbatim_confidence_language.description: The speaker's own words of likelihood, copied from inside the quote.

candidates_considered.description: Forward-looking statements you weighed, including those you rejected.
